I followed the Starbie guide and created my own Heartbie! I completed the schematic, PCB, and the firmware.

Some conflicts I faced:
- I wanted to make my PCB board light pink, but when I tried doing it, it became white. So I had to see what makes it light pink as a final look instead of white.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/FMEKnrb22frjFkpesXrjbdX7wDZPevrf/a0b8517af27277dd50e1b5564f8eb4339462941e4afb56b90a6df5b3004b23c1.png)

- Connecting the pins with the GNDs. I kept doing the pins to the GND instead of the GND to the pins so it was very weird and it wasn't working. However, when I tried doing it from the GND, it was working so that's how I figured it out.
